Set a value.description: Create a key (fails if it exists).

Set a value with a TTL.description: Create a key that deletes itself after a number of seconds.

Set if not exists.description: Create a key only when it is missing (re-runnable files).

Set a JSON document.description: Create a JSON document over several lines.

Change a document field.description: Change one field of a document.

Add to a number in place.description: Add a number to a field, in one step on the server.

Append to an array.description: Add values at the end of an array.

Query documents.description: Find documents by what they contain.

Query with and / or.description: Combine comparisons with and, or, not and parentheses.

Aggregate by group.description: count, sum, avg, min or max, one line per value of a field.

body: create index on ${1:user:} (${2:field})${3| using hash, using btree,|}$0
Create an index.description: A secondary index: btree for comparisons, hash for = only.

Explain a query.description: Show how a query will run, and the index it lacks.

Transaction with a savepoint.description: Go back to a bookmark inside a transaction.

Vector index (exact).description: Keep the vectors of a field in memory; exact search.

body: create vector index on ${1:doc:} (${2:embedding}) using hnsw metric ${3|cosine,dot,l2|}${4: quantize sq8}$0
tune vector index on ${1:doc:} (${2:embedding}) recall ${3:0.95} auto$0
Tune an HNSW index.description: Measure the ef_search the index needs, and again as it grows.

body: get similar ${1:doc:*}.${2:embedding} to [${3:0.1, 0.2, 0.3}]${4: where ${5:lang} = ${6:"fr"}} limit ${7:5} metric ${8|cosine,dot,l2|} return ${9:title}$0
Similarity search.description: Find the documents closest to a vector.

Semantic cache: lookup.description: The cached answer of this question, or of a near-identical one.

body: semantic store ${1:faq} text "${2:question}" vector [${3:0.12, -0.40, 0.88}] answer ${4:"answer"} ttl ${5:300} depends "${6:kb:*}"${7: since ${8:token}}$0
Semantic cache: store.description: Remember an answer; since: only if its data did not change after the lookup.

Lua script.description: Run Lua next to the data, atomically.

Trigger.description: Run a stored script when matching keys change.

User.description: Create an account and give it access to a workspace.

Workspace.description: Create a workspace and enter it.
